items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Clifford called me up, said, 'We got a record date.' We did a record date for Muse.

ctx.x: And then we played a college out there, a concert. Come on back to Philly and he went on back up to New York and Clifford called me up, said, "We got a record date." We did a record date for Muse. Was just released this year. It's called "Remembering Me," with the same personnel except we had Chris Anderson, blind Chris Anderson, playing piano. We had some vocals on there. A young man named Hank Diamond Smith that put words to "Prayer to the People," one of Clifford's arrangements, and the Powerful Paul Robeson,…
Incidentally, we had Clifford's daughter Donna singing and Thelonius Monk's daughter Boo-boo. Maybe you'll
